description: Main source file for a service management component, implementing service startup, thread management, and service state tracking within a single process environment.

methods.name: getArgv
methods.description: Constructs argument vector for service startup based on provided path and arguments.

methods.name: start_main
methods.description: Thread function to run a service's main function and update its running state.

methods.name: start_service
methods.description: Creates a thread to start a service with given start info.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the service management process, initializes and manages service threads.

methods.name: startProcess
methods.description: Starts a service process or thread based on service definition, handling different service types.

methods.name: setServiceState
methods.description: Updates the running state of a service in the internal hash map.

methods.name: freeServiceStartInfo
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for service start information.

methods.name: getServiceState
methods.description: Returns whether a specified service is currently marked as running.
